_about: Every field on the two AHCCCS CP-AO forms, who supplies it, validation, and where it lands on the PDF. Coordinates are PDF points, origin bottom-left, page 612x792. y = baseline for drawText.

constants.default_work_address: 1940 E Thunderbird Rd Ste 206, Phoenix, AZ 85022

cp101_individual_user_application.source_pdf: IndividualUserApplicationForm.pdf (CP-101 rev 12/2024, 4 pages, NOT fillable -> overlay text with pdf-lib)

fields.label: Is the organization an AHCCCS registered provider? YES/NO
fields.note: Missing this got a whole batch rejected 6/25/25

fields.note: Missing this got a whole batch rejected 6/25/25

fields.label: First Name
fields.validate: Legal name exactly as on driver's license; no nicknames

fields.label: MI
fields.validate: 1 letter or blank; write 'N/A' flag if none (form says all fields must be completed — AI should confirm staff explicitly chose 'No middle name')

fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.validate: Age >= 18; this exact field caused the Jared Bakin correction request (8/24/26) — show a confirm-retype step

fields.label: City and State
fields.note: Collect city + state separately in UI, render as 'City, ST'

fields.label: Email Address
fields.validate: Prefer @sanctuaryrecoverycenters.com (not the @sanctuaryrc.com alias) so CPAO training emails land in the right mailbox

fields.label: Read and agree to Conditions for Access (pages 2-3)
fields.note: Show the full page 2-3 text in a scroll box; require scroll-to-end + checkbox. Not drawn on PDF; the signature on page 4 is the legal acceptance. Store timestamp + IP in audit log.
